result.description: Fictional compact workstation graphics module designed for creative editing terminals, virtual set control rigs, and multi-display kiosk systems. Built around the Lumen Arc chipset with 24 GB of dedicated memory, it emphasizes quiet operation, low-profile installation, and stable output across four Mini DisplayPort connections. The module targets professional signage and lightweight visualization workloads rather than gaming or general-purpose compute.
result.title: Lumen Arc 24GB Studio Graphics Module
result.title_description: Compact workstation graphics module with 24 GB VRAM and four Mini DisplayPort outputs
